automatic_stop_rules: Refuse to start a block if projected cumulative spend exceeds the active stage ceiling.
Abort mid-block if realized cumulative spend crosses the active stage ceiling.
Stop at the next checkpoint on requested/reported model drift.
Stop the run for diagnosis if more than 25% of a block's attempts terminally fail.
Never add items or repeats after a route contrast has been observed; unused pilot budget cannot fund extra confirmatory observations.
enforcement: run_route_comparison.py reads this file and enforces the active stage ceiling and stop rules mechanically; the ceilings meter API-route token spend, and the sub-agent route is tracked by attempt count and wall-clock.
